manifest.description: Your business on your site: details, opening hours, contact details and a payment link, and the structured data search engines read. Write opening hours like 09:00-12:00, 13:00-17:00 (empty means closed). Special days like: 2026-12-25 closed Christmas Day; 2026-12-24 09:00-12:00 Christmas Eve.

type.label: Kind of business (Restaurant, Dentist, Hair salon, Shop...)

social.label: Your pages elsewhere (https:// addresses, separated by commas)

time_zone.label: Time zone of the business (for example Europe/Berlin)

special_days.label: Special days, separated by semicolons (see the description)
